summary: Single-line (TextField) and multi-line (Textarea) text fields with an automatically linked label, description, and error message. Field provides the same anatomy to custom controls; Form coordinates validation.
whenToUse: Short (name, email, code) or long (notes, descriptions) free-text input.
Field: to integrate a native or third-party control while keeping labels and errors consistent.
whenNotToUse: Numeric values with increments: use NumberInput.
Choosing from a known list: use Select, Combobox, or RadioGroup.
Passwords: use PasswordInput; search: SearchInput (with a clear button).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. If absent, provide aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown when the field is invalid; the function receives the validation details.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled mode (do not switch between the two).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives the new value (not the event).

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Required field: native required + localized visual and text indicator.

props.name: necessityIndicator
props.description: How to indicate that a field is required.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Forces the invalid state (e.g. a server error).

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation; return the error message.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native: errors shown on submit and submission blocked; aria: real-time errors without blocking.

props.name: isDisabled / isReadOnly
props.description: Disabled and read-only states (a read-only value stays selectable and is submitted with the form).

props.name: startAdornment / endAdornment
props.description: Icon or content before/after the input (start is decorative).

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Props of the <input> element (inputMode, list, enterKeyHint…).

props.name: type, name, autoComplete, minLength, maxLength, pattern
props.description: Native attributes forwarded to the input.

props.name: Textarea: rows / showCount
props.description: Visible rows and character counter (requires maxLength).

inherits: Props of react-aria-components TextField (onFocus, onBlur, onKeyDown, autoFocus, name, form…) and global DOM attributes on the container.

keyboard.action: Submits the form; focus moves to the first invalid field.

accessibility: Native <label for>, with description and error linked via aria-describedby.
The invalid state uses aria-invalid; the message is preceded by an icon (not color alone).
The asterisk is aria-hidden: the screen reader reads the localized text “required”.
With validationBehavior="native", submitting moves focus to the first invalid field.
The placeholder does not replace the label.
responsive: The field fills the container width; long labels and messages wrap.
The input font is 16 px to prevent automatic zoom on iOS.
Use the correct type/inputMode (email, tel, url) for suitable mobile keyboards.
customization: Height and padding from the density token (comfortable/compact).
commonMistakes: Showing errors with a red border only: always pass an errorMessage.
Using onChange as on a native input: here it receives a string.
Passing value without onChange (locked field): use defaultValue or isReadOnly.
Treating client-side validation as sufficient: always repeat it on the server.
